summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Bastar Mart Quick-Commerce website. All major features working correctly including homepage, categories, search, cart, and admin functionality.

design_issues.issue: Logout button click doesn't immediately redirect to login page

passed_tests: Backend API: All 24 endpoints tested and working
Homepage loads with hero section, categories (6), and products (19)
Shop by Category section displays all categories correctly
Category navigation works - clicking navigates to filtered products
Search functionality works - 'milk' search returns relevant results
Add to cart functionality works on all product cards
Cart sheet opens and displays items with correct totals
Admin dashboard loads with products and categories tabs
Admin can open add product dialog with all form fields
Admin can open add category dialog with all form fields
Cloudinary integration working for image uploads
JWT authentication working for admin routes
Product search and category filtering working
